slider.notes: simulator source type "slider" is placed as SC_LeverVertical; corpus confirms the footprint and 1/1 ports; twin "<prefab> M": ports reflected along local x (dx -> w-1-dx, x facing negated); mirrored_ports is read from the twin prefab itself
